canopy_reference.description: P_ref is defined in the central rib plane. Use chord_line to avoid contamination by profile thickness.

loaded_rib_selection.description: all_loaded selects every loaded boundary for the current canopy. explicit_rib_ids preserves a manual subset.

anchors.description: Tip anchors use the lower rib profile by default. If stabilizers.active and stabilizers.attach_tip_lines_to_stabilizer are true, external structural tip anchors move to the stabilizer edge. Set tip_anchor_mode='rib' to force rib anchors or 'stabilizer' to force stabilizer anchors.

cascades.description: P_cascade = centroid(children) + fraction_to_target*(target-centroid). Groups are created centre-to-tip on each side to enforce mirror symmetry.

angles.description: If theta_deg is null, theta = alpha_op + mu - gamma. v16 deliberately does not export long rigging-measurement diagnostics; the suspension/payload system is positioned using this theta relation and the report only checks the angular closure error.

constraints.description: R/b is solved by moving slider/risers/payload along the payload line defined by theta.

line_properties.description: For CD_lines_segmented, the incident velocity is defined in the central X-Z plane. velocity_reference='alpha_op' uses the canopy operating angle of attack; 'gamma' uses the glide angle; 'custom' uses incident_velocity_angle_deg.

risers.description: With active slider, front/rear risers are placed at slider corners. Brake actuators are offset from rear corners.

slider.description: Slider plane is perpendicular to the payload line. width is spanwise, depth is chordwise in the local slider plane.

payload.description: Local axes are depth, span, down-along-payload-line. Positive local z is downward from canopy to payload.

agu.description: AGU is an optional oriented box between slider and payload attach point.

brakes.description: Brake lines are independent from A/B/C/D. By default they terminate at AGU_CONTROL when the AGU is active, otherwise at the slider brake actuator.

stabilizers.description: Independent side panel on the two external ribs. For line anchors, this is the single main switch: set this true to move external structural tip anchors to the stabilizer edge. Default triangular panel uses UP_LE and UP_TE on the external rib plus an apex controlled by apex_x_c and height_mm. Lines are distributed along UP_LE-apex-UP_TE according to bank x/c, not collapsed at the apex. height_direction: rib_down, global_down, span_outward.

tip_side_bulge.description: Canopy-level optional curved external side panel. The lateral bulge is zero on upper and lower boundaries and at chordwise_start/end so the generated surface closes with the external upper/lower canopy panels instead of floating apart.

fabric_thickness.description: Recommended strategy: export mid-surfaces + shell thickness metadata for FEM; create physical thickness later in meshing/FEM software. CATIA offsets are experimental and disabled by default.
